top_five.text: An unprecedented Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has killed over 2,000 people across 4,381 cases as containment efforts struggle to keep pace.
A major 7.4-magnitude earthquake in western Colombia has killed up to 240 people and injured hundreds, leaving many trapped beneath collapsed structures.
Israeli forces reportedly struck the Abu Asi Orphan Camp in Gaza, where wounded staff continued assisting displaced residents seeking shelter.
Thousands of residents were evacuated from Beijing as torrential rainfall from Typhoon Dolphin heightened risks of severe flooding and landslides.
Overnight cross-border attacks between Russia and Ukraine killed four civilians, including a child in the port city of Novorossiysk.

top_story.quote: An unprecedentedly fast-spreading Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has killed over 2,000 people as response operations face critical disruptions from health worker strikes and delayed initial detection.
top_story.label: AFRICA — Ebola Outbreak Surpasses 2,000 Fatalities

Middle East.headline: Colombia — 7.4-Magnitude Earthquake Kills Over 240 People
Middle East.body: A 7.4-magnitude earthquake in western Colombia has killed at least 240 people, with search and rescue operations ongoing to locate survivors trapped beneath collapsed buildings. Rescuers successfully pulled a 32-year-old woman alive from the rubble in Cali two days after the disaster. Severe structural damage has been reported across affected cities, where many victims were buried under their homes. Numerous residents remain missing as search efforts continue.

Middle East.headline: Palestine — Strike Reported on Gaza Orphan Camp
Middle East.body: Israeli forces reportedly struck the Abu Asi Orphan Camp in Gaza. Following the attack, wounded personnel inside the camp continued assisting and caring for displaced residents seeking shelter at the site. Official casualty numbers and the full scale of damage to the facility remain unconfirmed due to limited details in available reporting.

Middle East.headline: Yemen — Defense Department Reports 153 Civilian Deaths from US Strikes
Middle East.body: The United States Department of Defense reported that US airstrikes in Yemen resulted in the deaths of 153 civilians last year. According to military statements, 15 individual strikes remain under official investigation to examine potential civilian harm and operational conduct.

Middle East.headline: Yemen/Red Sea — Fatal Strike Reported on Ship in Bab al-Mandeb Strait
Middle East.body: Yemeni officials reported six people were killed during a Houthi strike on a vessel in the Bab al-Mandeb Strait. The incident highlights continued military escalation and safety risks affecting commercial shipping and maritime traffic in the Red Sea region.

Americas.headline: Colombia — 7.4-magnitude earthquake causes severe damage and mass casualties
Americas.body: A powerful 7.4-magnitude earthquake struck western Colombia on Monday morning, causing widespread destruction and triggering multiple aftershocks through Tuesday. At least 180 people have been killed, according to the BBC, while rescue teams continue working to free survivors trapped under collapsed buildings and rubble. Local authorities reported hundreds of injuries and warned that the death toll is expected to rise further as emergency search and rescue operations proceed across affected areas.

Africa.headline: DR Congo — Ebola Outbreak Surpasses 2,000 Fatalities
Africa.body: Health authorities in the Democratic Republic of the Congo report that an Ebola outbreak has killed over 2,000 people, with total cases reaching 4,381. Described as the fastest-spreading on record, the outbreak reportedly began months prior to its official declaration. Containment efforts are failing to keep pace with transmission, compounded by health workers striking over pay, while researchers race to advance vaccine development and identify the origin of the outbreak.

Europe.headline: Russia/Ukraine — Cross-border overnight attacks leave four dead
Europe.body: Overnight attacks targeting locations in southern Russia and Ukraine resulted in at least four deaths. In the Russian port city of Novorossiysk, the local mayor reported that a child was killed and dozens of buildings were damaged during a night of heavy bombardment. The strikes highlight continuing civilian casualties and damage to infrastructure resulting from ongoing cross-border hostilities.

Europe.headline: Ukraine/Russia — Pyongyang-supplied missiles reported in Zaporizhzhia attack
Europe.body: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy accused North Korea of stepping up its military support for Moscow, stating that ballistic missiles supplied by Pyongyang were used in a recent deadly attack on Zaporizhzhia. Following the reported deployment of North Korean weaponry in Ukraine, Kyiv is pursuing closer diplomatic and security cooperation with South Korea.

Europe.headline: Ukraine/Russia — Kyiv submits peace proposals to US, warns of Russian mobilization
Europe.body: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy announced that Ukraine has submitted formal proposals to the United States regarding measures to end the war with Russia. Zelenskyy also warned that Moscow intends to use its upcoming elections next month as a pretext to declare a new military mobilization effort.

Asia-Pacific.headline: China — Typhoon Dolphin Floods
Asia-Pacific.body: Thousands of people have been evacuated from Beijing as the remnants of Typhoon Dolphin bring torrential rain across northern and central China. Forecasters warned that the Chinese capital could receive over 150 millimeters of rain within 24 hours, with localized districts expected to exceed 200 millimeters—representing more than one-third of Beijing's average annual rainfall of 528 millimeters. The heavy precipitation has heightened risks of widespread flooding and landslides, threatening communities, infrastructure, and local services in vulnerable areas.
verified_figures: Over 150mm of rain forecast within 24 hours (exceeding 200mm in some districts)

Asia-Pacific.headline: India — Assam Floods
Asia-Pacific.body: Flooding in the northeastern state of Assam, India, is escalating and inundating areas previously considered safe from severe waterlogging. The expanding scope of the floodwaters has disrupted local communities and forced residents to utilize improvised rafts for survival and emergency evacuation, illustrating the widening geographical impact and protection challenges for vulnerable populations across affected rural areas.

Global / Cross-Cutting.headline: East Africa — Ebola outbreak deaths surpass 2,000 amid record spread
Global / Cross-Cutting.body: An accelerating Ebola outbreak in East Africa has claimed over 2,000 lives, making it the fastest-growing outbreak of the virus on record. The epidemic reportedly spread undetected for months before being identified, severely complicating containment efforts across affected communities. In response, scientists are working to rapidly develop and deploy effective vaccines, while international partners mobilize aid. To support response operations in the region, the United States has pledged an additional 31 billion Kenyan shillings.
verified_figures: Ksh31 billion in extra US aid pledged

escalation_risks.trigger: Further Houthi strikes targeting commercial shipping vessels navigating the Bab al-Mandeb Strait over the next 72 hours.
escalation_risks.potential_impact: Continued attacks could cause additional fatalities, disrupt vital international maritime traffic, and trigger broader regional military responses.

escalation_risks.trigger: Expanded deployment of North Korean-supplied ballistic missiles in Russian strikes against Ukrainian targets.
escalation_risks.potential_impact: The use of advanced foreign ballistic weaponry threatens increased civilian casualties and infrastructure destruction across major urban populations.
